title: ai-tool-compliance-db
description: Schema for the AI Tool Compliance Database (ai_tools_db.json).

category.description: What kind of tool this is, e.g. 'General-purpose chatbot', 'Meeting transcription', 'AI medical scribe'.

trains_on_input_by_default.description: Whether the vendor trains models on user input at this tier by default.

oneOf.description: Free-text qualifier when the answer is conditional/nuanced.

baa_available.description: true = available at this tier; false = not available; "conditional" = available only under specific conditions (sales-managed account, admin activation, negotiated enterprise terms, etc.) — see baa_notes.

baa_notes.description: Required explanation of the baa_available value, especially for "conditional" entries.

confidence.description: 'verified' = confirmed against the vendor's own current published policy page as of last_verified, with source_urls populated. 'general_knowledge' = well-established public reporting, not individually re-verified in this build; lower confidence.

notes.description: Practical guidance for an engineer using this entry in a real engagement — what to double-check, common misconceptions, risk context.
